summary: Fullstack developer focused on building responsive web applications with Angular on the frontend and Django on the backend, with strong TypeScript fundamentals.

key_competencies.name: Component-driven frontend architecture
key_competencies.description: Designs reusable, strongly-typed Angular component libraries styled with TailwindCSS, reducing UI duplication across projects.

key_competencies.name: API design with Django REST Framework
key_competencies.description: Builds secure, well-documented REST APIs in Django, applying JWT authentication and query optimization for PostgreSQL-backed services.

notable_project.name: ENAPRES
notable_project.description: A data collection and analytics platform for the Encuesta Nacional de Programas Presupuestales, built with an Angular + TypeScript + TailwindCSS frontend and a Django REST Framework backend, handling structured survey submissions across multiple regions. This project laid the architectural groundwork (auth flow, component library, API conventions) that the candidate now reuses in current Angular + Django development.
notable_project.impact: Processed over 15,000 survey responses across 12 regions with 99.5% uptime, and cut average form-validation errors by 35% through strongly-typed Angular reactive forms shared across modules.
